procedures.name: Main
procedures.source:
&FixedText = "ab"
Print("fixed_short=[" + &FixedText + "]")
Print(&FixedText.Length())
&VariableText = "ab"
Print("variable_short=[" + &VariableText + "]")
Print(&VariableText.Length())
&FixedText = "abcdefg"
Print("fixed_long=[" + &FixedText + "]")
&VariableText = "abcdefg"
Print("variable_long=[" + &VariableText + "]")
&FixedText = " ab "
Print("fixed_spaces=[" + &FixedText + "]")
&VariableText = " ab "
Print("variable_spaces=[" + &VariableText + "]")
If &FixedText = " ab"
Print("fixed_equal=1")
Else
Print("fixed_equal=0")
EndIf
If &VariableText = " ab"
Print("variable_equal=1")
Else
Print("variable_equal=0")
EndIf
If "A" = "a"
Print("case_equal=1")
Else
Print("case_equal=0")
EndIf
&LongText = &FixedText + &VariableText
Print("concat=[" + &LongText + "]")
&FixedText = ""
Print("fixed_empty=[" + &FixedText + "]")
&VariableText = ""
Print("variable_empty=[" + &VariableText + "]")
&FixedText = "ação"
Print("fixed_unicode=[" + &FixedText + "]")
Print(&FixedText.Length())
&FixedText = "a😀b"
Print("astral=[" + &FixedText + "]")
Print(&FixedText.Length())
